platform.componentPreviewFormat: Native Unity descriptions; HTML and CSS previews do not represent this implementation.

background.purpose: Full-frame background and mine camera clear color.

panel.purpose: Expedition panel and full-panel settings, room map and workshop surfaces.

text.purpose: Primary Russian body text and disabled button captions.

secondary.purpose: Supporting instructions, progress details and secondary status text.

accent.purpose: Active controls, display title, XP fill and highlighted character or result information.

extensions.colorNotation: Canonical hex names are preserved from DESIGN.md; nativeValue records the actual normalized Unity Color values, which can differ slightly when rounded to 8-bit channels.

body.purpose: Russian headings, instructions, character statistics, resources and button captions.

nativeLayout.uiCoordinates: Stage pixels from top-left; y increases downward.

home.purpose: Keep all four resource rows visible above the menu actions.

nativeLayout.responsiveBehavior: Uniformly scale the centered reference stage; recalculate the board viewport on window resize.

depth.interface: Flat colored plates and tonal contrast.

motion.name: accepted-action
motion.purpose: Short movement beat interpolating the player to the settled grid position; a stationary dig pulses the player scale.

motion.name: boulder-tick
motion.purpose: Interpolate each group of boulder movements; fade destroyed boulders.

motion.name: fall-feedback
motion.purpose: Brief board-camera feedback following a fall.

framebuffer.invariant: Clear the entire frame before rendering the board viewport so removed UI labels and panels leave no stale pixels.

assets.sourceArt: Kenney Pixel Platformer and character sheet

components.name: Action button
components.description: Square amber Unity Image and Button with a centered Arial caption. Default height 54 stage pixels; caption inset is 12 horizontally and 6 vertically.
components.interaction: Mouse click; Tab selects the next interactable button; Enter invokes the selected action.

components.name: Expedition panel
components.description: Square slate right-hand panel for character progression, ore inventory and contextual actions.

components.name: Character and inventory
components.description: Amber level heading, secondary XP text, eight-pixel-high XP bar, pickaxe and protection statistics, then four ore-colored icon and text rows.

components.name: Mine board
components.description: Orthographic point-filtered pixel grid on the left, with distinct terrain, trail, ores, red hearts, boulders and player layers.

components.name: Forward mining preview
components.description: Amber preview marks the actual forward mining area; a small arrow indicates current facing. Optional red marks show possible falling-boulder cells.
components.visibility: Shown only during active play; hidden for menu appearance and completed or failed runs.

components.name: Full-panel views
components.description: Room map, workshop and settings occupy a slate left panel while retaining the expedition panel on the right.

narrative.overview: Pixel mine with a clear orthographic grid. The playfield occupies the left two thirds, a narrow expedition panel occupies the right. Source art is Kenney Pixel Platformer, rendered with point filtering; no pre-existing sprites are used. Hearts remain red, copper amber, iron cool gray, gold yellow, diamonds cyan.

rules.name: Puzzle analysis
rules.body: No decorative interface motion during puzzle analysis.

rules.name: Frame clearing
rules.body: Clear the full frame before drawing the board viewport to prevent stale UI pixels after screen changes.
